MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 15

4. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 11
   C. 12
   D. 8

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 41

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

10. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

15. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
